name: Endling — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Endling from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Endling (CR +2)" but are not part of the Endling entry, which is unchanged.

Hit Dice Change all of the creature’s species Hit Dice to d8s (most animals will already use d8s for Hit Dice), then add 2 additional HD if the new creature is size Large or smaller, 3 HD if it is Huge, and 4 HD if it is Gargantuan or larger. Endlings use their Charisma modifiers to determine bonus hit points (instead of Constitution).

Speed Even though it is insubstantial, an endling continues to move as it did during life. If the endling had a fly speed, its maneuverability increases to perfect.

Attacks As a free action, an endling can temporarily cause parts of its body to become substantial. This functions as a natural weapon that the species had in life, dealing a damage type that the living counterpart’s natural attack dealt.

Special Attacks An endling retains all the special attacks of the base creature, although those relying on physical contact may or may not function (see attacks). In addition, an endling gains the following special attacks. The save DC against an endling’s special attacks is equal to 10 + 1/2 the endling’s HD + the endling’s Charisma modifier unless otherwise noted.

Antitech Natural Weapons (Su)

A creature hit by an endling’s natural attack must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, a random hybrid or technological item worn or wielded by the target ceases to function for 1 round, and if the target is a technological construct (such as a robot, drone, or SRO), it is shaken for 1 round.

Demolition (Su)

When using its antitech natural weapons, and endling ignores an amount of hardness equal to twice its CR.

The endling can perform sunder combat maneuvers with a +4 insight bonus to its CMD and never provokes attacks of opportunity when doing so.

Abilities Str +4, Dex +2, Cha +8; as an undead creature, an endling has no Constitution score. Its Strength score applies only when it uses an ability to make itself substantial; otherwise it effectively has no Strength score.

Variant Endlings
Invasion Endling

Invasion endlings hold a grudge against specific beings—usually an invasive species, but sometimes unscrupulous hunters or careless colonizers.

Special Attacks An invasion endling gains the following special attacks instead of the antitech natural weapons and demotion special attacks of a standard endling.

Fearsome Roar (Su)

Vicious Natural Weapons (Su)

A creature that takes hit point damage from an invasion endling’s natural attack also takes bleed damage equal to 1/2 the invasion endling’s CR (minimum 1 point of bleed).

Plague Endling

These endlings were wiped out by some kind of pathogen—natural or unnatural—that their systems couldn’t adapt to.

Special Attacks A plague endling gains the following special attacks instead of the antitech natural weapons and demotion special attacks of a standard endling.

Diseased Natural Weapons (Su)

A creature hit by a plague endling’s natural attack must attempt a Fortitude save or be exposed to a poison whose symptoms closely mimic the disease that caused the endling’s species’ extinction (see below).

Plague Aura (Su)

A plague endling emits an aura of pestilence. All creatures that begin their turn within 30 feet of the plague endling must succeed at a Fortitude save or be affected by the plague endling’s poison (see below).
